a.text: Viviana Droste. That's your name.
You are the shame of the family. If other nobles find out about you, you will become their weapon, used to attack your father.
You should have been exiled in secret or killed outright. The spire should never have heard your cries.
Yet you were brought here to Kazimierz. You were entrusted to a Kazimierz campaign knight to raise.
Your identity should have stayed hidden, but there is nobody here to hide your identity.
It's as though everyone wanted you to live out in the open, unconcealed.
How respectable yet sorrowful... Your noble father... Your nameless mother... They both love you so.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Candle-flame... and shadows.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: What a surprise... You seem to have a good inductive reasoning of Arts phenomena.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: When a room is illuminated by only a single candle, the candlelight will naturally draw our attention more so than anything else. Yet it is the shadows of everything around that truly engulf us.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Impressive techniques, Viviana... Not even my light... can shine upon you.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Please allow me to apologize.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Out of courtesy, I should call you by your name too, Miss Margaret.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Is... Is this really the a knight competition?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It looks like neither of the knights are in a rush to slaughter her opponent for a win. On the contrary, you could say this scene is like an elegant aristocratic social gathering!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: B-But even so—Did you see those Arts?! The Candle Knight's lightning-quick swordhand! Did it just engulf all that light?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Is the Radiant Knight's endless radiance starting to wear thin?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Just a small candle-flame—That's right, it's just a tiny candlelight, but check out its surroundings! The flame is engulfed by the darkness around, and it's that unlit darkness, not the candle's light, that's drawing our attention!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Rather than that tiny glow, you could say the Candle Knight is controlling the shadows underneath that light!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Gotta hand it to them! This isn't something you often see in our matches, not even the finals!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Their Arts are calm and elegant, but there's no mistake that these Arts are of the highest caliber!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That's the Radiant Knight, Margaret Nearl, and the Candle Knight, Viviana Droste, we know and love!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria? Maria!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Where is she...? She's not at the bar, and she's not home...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nnf... nnf...!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Why am I...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You...? You're that...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Armorless Union.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh, calm down.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: As long as you promise you won't make a fuss, we won't do anything to you.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: After all, if the Nearl family's precious little baby got hurt... the Radiant Knight and Młynar wouldn't just sit around and not do anything.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You want to... make Margaret forfeit?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Something like that.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Do you know what happened to Brassrust? The Infected are the talk of the town right now.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Could you imagine what would happen if, under these circumstances, the Radiant Knight ends up taking the crown?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Your sister just has to be a good girl and let the Candle Knight win. That will save us all the headache. Pretty simple, don't you agree?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret isn't going to forfeit.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Did you know, Maria Nearl?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Kazimierz... is like a tower. If you stand at its base and look up at the top of the spiraling staircase, you will never, ever see its end.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: V! Kowal! Marcin!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria might've been—

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: What happened to Maria?!

a.text: I have wondered for a long, long time.
What are we suffering for?
Compared to the farmers of Ursus's barren soil, the refugees escaping Bolívar's flames of war, and the merchants making their way across Sargon's endless golden sands...
Are we not enjoying our lives?
No.
Ursus has nobles living their high lives, Bolívar has war profiteers swimming in money, and Sargon's golden city must be one of the most prosperous metropolises the world has ever seen.
In that case, what is the source of Kazimierz's sufferings? As 'knights,' as Kazimierzian knights, how are we to handle these tragedies hidden from view?
No.
To start, am I really a knight of Kazimierz?
Should I have stayed in Leithania, writing poems and songs amid flowers and accordion melodies?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Why don't you try your hand at writing a few poems? With how popular you are, I can get in touch with a few publishers. Your fame and talent will...

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Me...? I'm afraid... I can't.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You're being humble again.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: No, this isn't humility, McKee.

a.text: I might have gone numb.
I thought I had left Leithanien and left that spire behind. It wasn't until afterwards that I realized this. The spire is still there. It has always been there.
It has always stood above all suffering and tribulation.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: ...Margaret.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: When you set a tall, magnificent spire ablaze, how far away can the masses see the smoke?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Flames cannot burn away the contradictions in their hearts.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The masses can see the black smoke from far, far away, but it may once have been their homes, the lands on which they survived.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: In that case... I truly don't understand.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: How does a knight like you return to Kazimierz, if not for a change of heart? What is your objective?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's just as you said, Viviana.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The times are changing, but that does not mean what we once considered virtuous and righteous must change.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I came back because I must remind the knights of Kazimierz... as well as all those who are here in this country—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: —I'm here to remind them of their long forgotten glory.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Remind? How will you... remind Kazimierz of anything, given its current state?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You want an answer from me... but I'm afraid I don't necessarily have that right. This isn't something that can be done through simple conversation.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: My... You can read minds with your Arts?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'm only grasping more and more of your honesty by the minute.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Also, you asked me what I saw in my years of exile.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've witnessed... the greatest tragedy this world has seen.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I've seen the Infected's struggles at death's door, I've seen great cities crumble and fall as Catastrophes rained down upon them.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Is that the suffering you've seen...? In this world that you pity...?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I have excellent companions.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No... excellent doesn't adequately describe them anymore. They... possess a brilliant shine, a testament to their ideals.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's true. I was once lost, Viviana.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Anyone would be lost if they had taken the crown and been exiled at your age.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But things are different now. At the end of my long journey, I found friends whom I can trust. I realized where my beliefs lie.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'm alone no longer.
Margaret lodges her longsword into the ground.
Without a sound, the knight's radiance emanates throughout the arena, with gold seemingly flowing through her eyes.
She will be the lighthouse and foundation of everything here.
She will stand solemnly in this place till she ceases, perhaps even till the end of times.
Even if no one has walked the path she alone illuminates—
—There is nothing to fear any more.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Report. Platinum, ma'am... We've already informed the Knights Association.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: However, the match is still ongoing.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I sure wish the Knights Association would get on with this already. Otherwise, her sister's going to have to suffer.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I told you. Margaret isn't going to forfeit.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: No biggie. I'm sure she won't be in any mood for her next match when she sees your fingers laid out side by side at your family's front door.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Look at your eyes... So defiant. You're a weird one. No, both you and your sister are weird.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You may come from a famous line of heroes, but do you know how many lackeys the General Chamber has here in the Grand Knight Territory?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So you have the Radiant Knight and Młynar. The two of them together might put up a little fight, but what can they really do? Can they really take on the thousands of assassins here in the GKT and escape legal liability?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I don't remember you being such a talkative gal... Are you nervous?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I mean, before, all I had to do was draw my bowstring, aim, and let go. Then, my target would die after a quick flash of pain.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: These orders I've been getting, though? Not only do I have to go after kids now, I also have to arm wrestle with the Radiant Knight. *Sigh*... Work sucks.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Armorless Union's really gone to hell lately, hasn't it?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Report!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Did the Radiant Knight give up?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: No, it's just... E7 and E9 didn't answer during the regular check-in just now...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Why are you standing there, then? Get ready to fight.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: All units, deploy immediately. Secure vantage points A1 and A2. Do not give the target a chance to escape.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Numbers three and four, cover me. We'll deal with the infiltrators.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (An explosion? They aren't the least bit worried about the hostage, are they—?)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (—No, that's not right. They're not here to rescue Maria.)

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Hostiles in the smoke! Watch for attacks—

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Nngh–...

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Loud clicking noises)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What's this...? A delivery cart?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Well, hello, Armorless lackeys.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Grr... Infected knights, huh...?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Whoa, huge backflip. Look at that distance. You're a nimble one—Hm?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Maria Nearl? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: It's... it's you...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, can you move?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Y-Yes!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I don't know what's going on, but I ain't about to complain if this means the Radiant Knight's gonna owe me a favor.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Let's get this out of the way first. It's a serious crime to assault the Armorless Union. Haha, not in the legal sense, but whatever.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You can run away if you want, or—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —If I don't stop them here, they will keep going after my sister.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Whew, not a bit of hesitation. I'm starting to like you.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Too bad, though. I'm not gonna have it on my conscience to drag anybody into our fight against the Armorless. Besides, I get the feeling Sona's pretty fond of you. You'll have to do this another time!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Toland!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: W-What?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Huh? Who are you?!

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Come with me, will you, Young Lady Nearl? Oh, and by the by? You and your uncle are nothing alike.

steps.name: A Kazimierz Knight
steps.text: Report to the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi... It's confirmed. The Armorless Union and the Infected knights' skirmish has begun. Maria Nearl's been taken away too.

steps.name: A Kazimierz Knight
steps.text: It will do as long as the Radiant Knight's match goes uninterrupted. Over.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: How long has it been since the match started? No one in the arena today has ever seen two knights duel like this!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Even Arts laymen can tell right away theirs are on another level!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This is a battle of lights! There's no doubt this has become the theme of this match! A weak candlelight versus a full-blown radiance!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Up till 9 o'clock, we've had two million viewers watching this match via the intercity net and other means!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: For the first time since the 22nd Major, when the Radiant Knight took her title, we've broken the highest concurrent viewer record! There are countless viewers watching Margaret's heroics right this moment!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ah, what a shame! I wish we lived in one of those sci-fi novels where fans from all the other countries could watch this match live—Ahhh!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The giant rays of light clash again—How blindingly bright! But amidst the rolling waves of light—That's right! The Candle Knight remains unscathed!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Brilliant... Viviana.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: With light and shadows... you weaved an untreadable swath of land.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I am honored that my little candle-flame could hold the Radiant Knight down for so long.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: But you don't seem to be giving it your all. Are you perhaps worried about your family?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: What are you doing is contradictory, Margaret.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: You take pride in having such wonderful companions, but the course that you have charted for yourself... will cause you to leave your friends behind.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Perhaps one day, your sister will meet her fate in one of the Armorless Union's conspiracies, and the General Chamber will stand in your way, wherever you will be.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Viviana.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: When the knight charged toward the endless waves, did you imagine that he was trying to overcome the entire world?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Ahh, so you are familiar with that knight legend.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: My sister's a big fan of the book.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Centaurea's been ambushed by the Infected. It was Wild Mane.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: If she can't take care of the likes of Wild Mane, then she should hand in her resignation already.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: That said... What should we do? The K.G.C.C. made it clear they want the Infected dealt with... and as soon as possible.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hmm... They are quite a pain in the rear... but we need them to keep stirring up a ruckus for us...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You're our star performer. It's your call.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Oh? Was that a compliment? You know, I've always thought that I look kinda like some star out there, ever since I dyed my hair blue.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Okay, okay, stop glaring at me like that. It's very simple. Kill a few of them, and as cruelly as possible, too. Spread the fear.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The ones left behind will come to hate Kazimierz and the K.G.C.C. even more, and things will only get more intense.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Eh, so, let's dump all the troublesome mess on our little Platinum.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Let's kill some Infected. The ones who aren't knights or in the limelight. Just the perfect amount of cruelty, like we're hunting them down.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Huff...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I see, so the moment your candle goes out is when you actually start casting.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Even a brief moment of darkness is enough to swallow my Arts whole. In that case, perhaps you can engulf the entire arena's light with each flicker of your candle's flame?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Impressive observation. There has never been a knight who saw through my Arts during a duel. Is this the result of your years-long exile?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Too bad, then. It seems I have yet to truly make contact with you.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I used to hate Arts more so than anything. The more outstanding my Arts are, the more I am reminded of my upbringing—

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: And the more I come to realize... the situation I am in.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Tell me, Margaret Nearl, the Radiant Knight. Each and every knight who keeps the faith feels particularly curious about you.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Tell me your answer. Your answer of what it means to be a knight.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: —Both the Radiant Knight and the Candle Knight have stopped. They're cautiously sizing each other up, taking a stroll around the arena—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What's the matter? Is this a tea party to the two of them? Are the two knights going to share a dance together after all that careful probing?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Hoh, did you hear that? He said we could dance.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Please, then.
Like the gentle morning sun, her beaming radiance begins to extend its reach toward the candle-lit darkness.
Soon after, the light begins to flood the entire arena.
Kawalerielki tonight is as brilliant as any bright, clear day.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: The Nearl girl went this way, didn't she? Quick, find her!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: —There's no one here!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: How can that be?! This place's listed in her file! It's Tremoriron Knight's bar!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Check if there's an attic or an exit out back—

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Misters, I'm afraid we're not open right now.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Don't you dare!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Erk...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Don't you kill them, V. Not unless you want shit to really hit the fan.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hah, how about you have a guess at how many artillery casters I captured during the war all those years ago to earn my military honors?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Son of a...! How dare you?! We're—

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The Armorless Union? How about before that? Were you a robber? A bounty hunter? A veteran, or perhaps a down and out knight?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Let me tell you. We aren't scared of you.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You dare cross the Union even once, the Union will hunt you to the ends of the world.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: It might happen today... maybe tomorrow. It might happen when you're eating, when you're asleep, or when you're spreading marmalade on your toast... You'll have nowhere to run!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Thanks for the advice. *Spit*.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: To be honest, though, the Armorless ain't nearly as scary as the vanguards.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hah! I haven't felt as good as this in years!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Looks like their buddies are on to this... Sorry, Marcin, but that might be it for your shop.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oh, that's too bad. I paid two years' worth of rent upfront.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You! What have you done?!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: You dare resist—Form up, ready your crossbows—Uh?
The Armorless points his crossbow forward.
The bowstring has snapped. More accurately, it is being twisted.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: W-What?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Ugh?!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: It's been a while since I used any Arts... Guess I've gotten rusty.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hmph, since when did the Armorless have this many men?! The K.G.C.C.'s got too much money to throw around, huh?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hah, that's why we wiped the floor with all of them!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Watch out! The bald guy's Tremoriron Marcin, and the other two are campaign knights!

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Keep two squads here. Keep them alive. They will be our trump card against Nearl. The rest of you, find Maria—

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hey, this isn't looking good, V!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You want to try begging for mercy, then?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Ready, fire—

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: What? Who is it this time?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What have you done to Maria?!
Radiance. The word 'radiance' is starting to be wear on everyone in the arena.
The sun-like prismatic colors dye the area behind the Radiant Knight. Standing opposite her is a small candlelight that has lit anew.
Then, right when the audience is starting to grow tired of finding the two knights in the blinding glow...
The faint sphere—Its rays, its halos, and all its light blink away.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Viviana... You are truly impressive...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Look, my light... have been swallowed whole... *Pant*.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I'm honored to have exhausted the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: But it seems you rely on more than just your dazzling Arts.
With her Candle Sword held up high, the Candle Knight begins to steadily lower her blade.
The candle's flame has extinguished, leaving behind a glistening brilliance on its milk white cross section.
The candle, now halved, flutters down toward the earth like a feather.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: You've broken my blade. It seems I have lost.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I, The Candle Knight, Viviana Droste, admit defeat.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Candle Knight has conceded! I didn't hear that wrong, did I—? The Candle Knight has just accepted defeat! The committee has confirmed her request. So there you have it—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: After this excruciating, protracted duel, the winner is our young legend, the Radiant Knight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Radiant Knight, suddenly returned from exile, has defeated her first Grand Knight opponent after an extraordinary match of the highest level!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Candle Knight may have suffered defeat, but there is no doubt she is basking in glory! The two knights are shaking hands and trading salutes! Take a good look! This scene is going to be all over the headlines the next couple weeks!

steps.name: A Spectating Knight
steps.text: What?! The Candle Knight lost?! That's a couple months' paychecks down the drain!

steps.name: A Cheering Knight
steps.text: Serves you right for not listening to me... Not that I earned much myself, but well... *Sigh*... This match's probably giving me some kind of eye disease down the line.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Hnnf...

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: To be a knight is to be the noble light that illuminates the land...

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Viviana.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I won't comment on your background—and that matter that weighs on your mind. However, you are among the strongest knights I have ever met.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: That is more than enough.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: In the classic knight tales... the knights always opened their hearts to each other by crossing swords.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Reality has proven to be less romantic. Though I've only just met you today, Margaret.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Show me how far you will go.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I'm looking forward to seeing.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Tch—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: (—I managed to block that strike, but I still almost lost my grip on my weapon—She's tough—)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: My next shot will pierce through your legs. You won't be able to run anymore.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The next shot after that will pierce through your armor.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The final shot will blow right through your chest. You'll struggle in agony for a moment, before dying in the dirty, wet street.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hah... No wonder Sona told me to run as soon as I ran into an Armorless elite.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You've really hit it big for someone your age. Bet the people higher up the ladder there are some serious monsters, eh?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You'd better pray you never find out—Hm?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Wild Mane! We'll cover you! Get out of here!

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Hurried beeping noises)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Alright, Justice, if that's what you say. Today's not the day for us to settle the score with the Armorless anyway.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: See you next time, Platinum!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: She's gone.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What's her deal with explosives...?! *Cough*, there's ash everywhere... and I just washed my hair.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: *Sigh*... How am I supposed to explain this...?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: No need to explain anything.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We saw all that.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: A fair number of the Infected just now are part of the Pinus Sylvestris.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: They banded the Infected together fairly quickly. Since when has the Grand Knight Territory had this many Infected?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: If we have to play the blame game, I guess that's on both the sloppy engineering contractors and the Catastrophes.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That's why we need Area 0 to do its job... Oh.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Little pegasus? I have a favor to ask you.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Ask away... I just screwed up in front of my bosses. I'm not about to object.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Will you investigate this company for us? They have dealings with the Radiant Knight, and they are in Area 0 right now.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We'll take over this whole thing about the Infected... And this company has to do with the Radiant Knight anyway. I'd say it falls under your purview.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I just need to investigate?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: They were even gung-ho enough to get in touch with the General Chamber. Man, it looks like this foreign company is extra greedy.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: If they prove beneficial to us, then they can do whatever they want. I'll even be okay if they end up solving the Radiant Knight problem with money.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But this whole affair is up to the Board of Directors. Somebody there will come looking for you soon. No need to worry about what we think.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What will you two do, then?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Since when have you had the right to question the Lazurites' business?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I... I wouldn't dare.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Now do your job.

steps.name: An Audience Member A
steps.text: It's the Candle Knight! Please sign this for me!

steps.name: An Audience Member B
steps.text: Candle Knight! Look this way, please! Ah—!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You look like you're in a good mood.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Did you know, McKee?

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: I heard that the Radiant Knight's legend as the youngest ever champion ended with her exile.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: She was infected and then exiled, but it wasn't until I met her six years later that I realized this: They are all tall tales.

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: Just now...

steps.name: Candle Knight
steps.text: ...she was as radiant as the sun at high noon.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Phew... That was a pleasant meeting, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm sure you've gained the favor of the top brass. Those were all key members of the General Chamber of Commerce.

options: Thank you very much. This is all thanks to you.
I learned quite a few things.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But my guess is... You are seeking more than just a mutual relationship on paper, right?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm curious... are there many researchers familiar with the battlefields of commerce in other countries?

options: Society is changing. It's a necessity.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Your hotel isn't much further.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, this is pretty close to where I got my first job. Back then, I was just your average trader—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Urghh—

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: —! Step back, Doctor!
An Infected knight, injured from unknown causes, turns to your face with a stupefied look.
You can tell that there is not a hint of anger, fear, or sorrow in this man.
But you have not had the chance to truly analyze his complex emotions. Right now, he is like a burdenbeast being flogged.
The man strenuously climbs to his feet and runs away.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Mr. Spokesman, this is...?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Who was that just now?

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: An illegal Infected. If you would like, we can send you the documents later.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: I apologize. Even though you are a spokesman, I can't divulge more when there is an outsider in your presence.

steps.name: An Armorless Union Member
steps.text: Please take your friend and evacuate immediately. There's been a confrontation in the neighborhood.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: My apologies. I hope that didn't dampen your spirits.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I didn't expect we would run into trouble like that after the banquet...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't have that power...

options: For your friendship with Rhodes Island.

steps.text: Malkiewicz looks silently in the direction the Infected knight ran away.
There is a small alleyway, from which he can hear music playing and see waves of heat wafting out of a midnight diner.
The knight's blood trail extends into the distance.
Like gemstones sparkling with humanity.
